question: Within each of Hamdan patients 4 and 83, does a positive inflamed-derived versus noninflamed-derived post-challenge RNA contrast also represent a larger response after subtracting that patient's concurrent-control history contrast?
decision: Retain complete donor-specific P/B/R_I/R_NI/A decompositions, both normalizations and raw-zero strata to distinguish baseline offsets, stronger induction and less repression. Agreement strengthens only finite-source relative-RNA description; discordance narrows that interpretation. Return complete results for review without adding a score, pathway or cohort to obtain a favorable extension.
strongest_rival: Post-challenge differences may reflect concurrent baseline offsets, relative library composition, low abundance plus pseudocount, normalization, or donor/site/culture composition rather than enhanced response. Donor matching does not identify causal history effects. Unknown replicate nesting prevents treating library suffixes as extra patients or matched cultures.
discriminator: Explicit per-patient A=(I_T-I_control)-(NI_T-NI_control)=P-B on the declared mean-normalized-count-then-log scale, with both constituent responses. Full eligible and any-raw-zero/no-raw-zero sign tables, total-count sensitivity and all sixteen unpaired library-combination extrema expose measurement dependence; they do not establish a mechanism, speed or function.
exposure_record: Hamdan main and supplementary results including STEM/S7 are exposed, alongside completed Naik S2-S6C. The coordinator performed the bounded 19 November literature/source review and approved S6 rationale plus S7 method with a prospective raw-count-zero-strata addition. Before draft preparation only official source metadata, count header, hashes and supplement were read; no new Hamdan gene effects were computed. Fourteen constructed-data tests and the plotted preview use artificial values only. Concrete contract/source-map/implementation review is complete; the coordinator authorized frozen execution after setup checks. The unchanged exact map is additionally bound as execution configuration under the existing S6A precedent; no scientific choice changed.
biological_unit: Two labeled patients (4 and 83), each with inflamed-derived I and noninflamed-derived NI intestinal organoids and two deposited library records in each concurrent control/shared-challenge condition. Exact culture/aliquot and technical-versus-biological replicate nesting remains unknown; the computational unit is a deposited bulk-RNA library.
nesting_and_overlap: Sixteen libraries nested within two donor labels and four history/condition cells per donor. Do not infer matched cultures from suffixes, count genes/libraries/combinations as patients or pool donors for population inference. This reuses Hamdan GSE282444 and is not independent replication of Hamdan or Naik. Scratch donor overlap 4/83 is observed but individual numeric phenotype/culture/time joins remain unqualified.
population_and_selection: Exact 16 GSM/column identities in S7_HAMDAN_SOURCE_MAP_V1.json. Exclude exactly 36 separate baseline-triplicate columns and four patient-4-only TNF100 columns; no substring selection. Retain every unique supplied GeneId/annotation in source-row order, all biotypes/chromosomes. Per-donor distribution eligibility is any of its eight raw counts positive; all-eight-zero genes remain exported, flagged and outside that donor's distribution denominator.
contrast: For each donor and normalization: e_hc=log2(mean of the two counts divided by library factors +1), B=e_I0-e_NI0, P=e_IT-e_NIT, R_I=e_IT-e_I0, R_NI=e_NIT-e_NI0, A=P-B=R_I-R_NI. One 24-hour endpoint: response magnitude, not speed. Export A minima/maxima from all 2^4 unpaired individual-library log contrasts as finite spread, not confidence intervals.
endpoint: Relative normalized bulk gene counts and regularized log2 response contrasts. Positive A can describe induction or less repression; report R_I and R_NI. No absolute RNA, pathway activation, epigenetic memory storage, barrier/closure, causal history or repair endpoint.
methods: Primary per-donor eight-library MOR uses all genes positive in all eight, per-gene geometric mean, ordinary median of ratios (arithmetic middle-pair mean), then factor geometric-mean centering. Sensitivity uses all-gene library totals/geometric mean totals. No empty-reference replacement. Group mean before log2(+1). All-row export, distinct raw/count/contrast/range zero flags, fixed 1e-10 computational sign tolerance, complete full-eligible 3x3 P/A and R_NI/R_I sign tables and separate any-raw-zero/no-raw-zero strata with exact counts/denominators/fractions; empty strata have null fractions. Quantiles use linear interpolation. Independent stdlib CSV/SOFT/50-digit Decimal verifies factors, every output row, all 16 ranges and all summaries. Six-panel all-eligible density display, no gene selection.
missingness_and_exclusions: No imputation, marker filter, annotation replacement, history relabeling, sample exclusion or baseline-triplicate substitution. Zero is a supplied numeric count. Stop on source hashes/identities, malformed width/header, missing/duplicate GeneId/column, absent sample, ambiguous metadata, invalid noninteger/negative/nonfinite counts, counts/totals outside exact float integer range, nonpositive totals/factors, empty MOR reference or verification mismatch. No alternative dose/normalization/universe is substituted.
multiplicity: Every gene, two donors and two declared normalizations are retained with full denominators. No p-values, inferential confidence intervals, equivalence tests, outcome-selected gene sets, enrichment, replication count or novel-mechanism claim. Raw-zero strata are prospective descriptions, not a new primary universe or biological threshold.
precision_basis: Finite-source arithmetic and sensitivity description; no patient-population precision or power. Two donors and unresolved within-donor nesting do not support libraries/genes-as-patients inference. Computational tolerance 1e-10 and +1 are declared numerical conventions, not biological margins. Unpaired extrema are finite spread, not sixteen independent experiments.
interpretation_limit: This distinct response estimand does not reproduce exact STEM inputs/membership or show that authors ignored baseline. Preserve main DESeq2 versus supplement edgeR and GEO HiSeq4000 versus paper NextSeq2000 discrepancies, and S7B repeated patient-4 condition text. Pairing does not remove anatomical-site/culture alternatives. No matched functional model, kinetics, chromatin causation, new RQ or claim acceptance follows; A1/Arz1 ownership remains intact.
